verdict.summary: The change is narrowly scoped to the stale re-admission diagnostic and leaves the arm/refusal decision unchanged. The new helper derives its wording from the same aggregator grade used by the census and absent-CI alarm, and the production call site passes that live grade. Tests independently pin the absent-vs-readable message split, shared head/budget facts, the production wiring, continued arming on absence, and the readable-gate control; expected wording is locally specified rather than read from the implementation. No fail-open control, trust check, permission, token path, or workflow surface is weakened.
